answer_1.quote: Instruction fine-tuning is an effective approach for enhancing zero-shot and few-shot performance on previously unseen tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses in instruction-following tasks and reasoning tasks, including zero-shot evaluation on MT-Bench with multi-turn questions across aspects like Writing, Roleplay, Reasoning, Code, Math, Extraction, STEM, and Humanities.
